tools.heroSubtitle: Margin, pip value, swap — pre-trade math without the spreadsheet.
tools.calcMarginDesc: The margin is the amount of capital required to open and maintain your position. It scales linearly with position size and inversely with leverage.
tools.calcPipFormula: Pip value = Lot size × Pip size × Contract size
tools.calcPipDesc: Each pip movement on your position is worth this amount. Multiply by your expected pip gain/loss to estimate P&L.
tools.calcSwapFormula: Swap = Swap rate × Lot size × Days
tools.calcSwapDesc: Swap is charged daily for holding positions overnight. Wednesday swap is tripled to account for the weekend.
